title: feat(ui): badge the F2 Continue route when a token-sitter checkpoint exists
context:
Continuing a cold session already needs no typed prompt, but nothing
told the user a durable checkpoint was there to pick up — so add a
small ✅🪑 badge on the recommended "Continue" route when one exists.

- server.py: new extract_session_token_sitter_checkpoint() globs
  ~/.claude/token-optimizer/checkpoints/<sid>-*.md (token-sitter's own
  naming), exposed at GET /api/session/<sid>/token-sitter-checkpoint
- static/app.js: f2RenderComposer fetches it (cached per session) and
  appends the badge
decision: Introduced server.py, static/app.js: added extract_session_token_sitter_checkpoint, f2TokenSitterCheckpointExists, f2PaintTokenSitterBadge.
